# Uptrace

> > OpenTelemetry-powered APM and observability platform with Go database clients (Bun, go-pg) and ClickHouse integration.

Uptrace provides distributed tracing, metrics, and logging using OpenTelemetry standards. The ecosystem includes Bun ORM for PostgreSQL/MySQL/MSSQL, go-pg PostgreSQL client (maintenance mode), and ClickHouse client for Go applications.

## Key Topics

- OpenTelemetry
- Uptrace APM
- Bun ORM
- go-pg PostgreSQL client
- ClickHouse
- Distributed tracing
- Observability
- PostgreSQL
- MySQL
- Go database drivers
- Application monitoring
- Usage-based pricing
- Database connections
- Query building

- [Pricing | Uptrace](https://uptrace.dev/pricing): Uptrace pricing with usage-based billing, free trial, and volume discounts

- [How to Choose an APM Solution: 5 Critical Questions for 2025 | Uptrace](https://uptrace.dev/blog/how-to-choose-an-apm): APM selection guide with criteria for evaluating monitoring tools in 2025

## Bun ORM Documentation

- [Bun: Drivers and dialects](https://bun.uptrace.dev/guide/drivers.html): Bun ORM database drivers and dialects for PostgreSQL, MySQL, MSSQL

## go-pg PostgreSQL Client

- [Getting started - PostgreSQL client and ORM for Go](https://pg.uptrace.dev): go-pg PostgreSQL client setup guide (maintenance mode, use Bun instead)
- [Writing queries - PostgreSQL client and ORM for Go](https://pg.uptrace.dev/queries): go-pg query builder guide for writing SQL with Go models
- [FAQ - PostgreSQL client and ORM for Go](https://pg.uptrace.dev/faq): go-pg FAQ covering connection health, queries, and troubleshooting
